channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: How the Polycab case exposes the misuse of IBC for small dues
item.description: Insolvency proceedings over minor vendor claims can exert commercial pressure on financially sound companies, even as courts warn against using the bankruptcy code as a debt-recovery tool.

item.title: California settles 23andMe data breach claims for $6 million
item.description: 23ANDME-BANKRUPTCY/SETTLEMENT (PIX):California settles 23andMe data breach claims for $6 million

item.title: Why is Amazon threatening to axe 5,000 delivery jobs over Zohran Mamdani’s labour law in New York? What govt can do
item.description: Amazon has warned that it could cut over 5,000 delivery jobs and close 15 New York City facilities if Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s proposed Delivery Protection Act becomes law. The bill would require direct employment of drivers, prompting concerns over job losses, delivery costs and worker protections.

item.title: Walmart seeks $2.5 billion from US bond sale, weighs first Canadian-dollar offering
item.description: Retail giant attracts over $14 billion in demand for US debt as spending plans and funding diversification drive borrowing strategy

item.title: Vinted Cracks Down on Looted Goods After French Riots
item.description: Vinted, a secondhand online marketplace that counts France as one of its largest markets, has seen an influx of listings suspected to contain looted items after riots broke out across the country.

item.title: 'Indian startup ecosystem is on steroids' - Anand Mahindra shares what excites him most, says my salute to them
item.description: Anand Mahindra praised India’s startup ecosystem, highlighting companies including Ethereal Machines, Pranos Fusion Energy and Scimplify. He said young entrepreneurs are developing advanced manufacturing, fusion and chemical technologies that could help India leapfrog stages of development.

item.title: Bajaj Finance to shrink lending to reckless borrowers
item.description: Bajaj Finance is halving the share of new loans to customers with three or more lending relationships to 3.5% by March 2027 amid concerns indebtedness.

item.title: Who earned ₹1 cr per annum salary while many got layoffs? These job professionals got pay package in 8 figures amount
item.description: The report identifies four major areas where specialised skills are attracting higher pay: AI, data, cloud computing and cybersecurity.

item.title: UltraTech flags prolonged cost pressure as West Asia crisis keeps fuel prices volatile
item.description: UltraTech's experience bodes ill for smaller rivals, as the cement industry struggles to absorb prolonged input cost increases.

item.title: Tata Trusts files response to Venu Srinivasan, Vijay Singh's complaints before Maharashtra Charity Commissioner
item.description: Srinivasan and Singh lodged their complaints on September 25, seeking an inquiry into the trust's administration and governance, including its role in the commercial affairs of Tata Sons.

item.title: Aegis Logistics in talks with BNP Paribas, HSBC, JPMorgan to raise $600 million for Tristar deal
item.description: Aegis Logistics Ltd. is in talks with banks including BNP Paribas SA, HSBC Holdings Plc and JPMorgan Chase & Co. about raising funds for its acquisition of Dubai-based Tristar Holdings Ltd., people familiar with the matter said.

item.title: PEs, strategics eye minority stake in Zoff Foods at over ₹1,000 crore valuation
item.description: The Raipur-based company, which competes with the likes of MDH Spices and Everest Food Products, will look to tap both private equity firms and strategic investors including ITC, Emami and Orkla India for the funding round.

item.title: DP World ties next $2 billion India investment to demand, capacity constraints
item.description: The Dubai-based company has already invested $3 billion in India, with the balance $2 billion earmarked for expanding existing operations, including port terminals, inland container depots, warehousing and logistics facilities.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘First of many’: Elon Musk plans to give every American child one SpaceX share next year, but details remain unclear
item.description: Elon Musk said he plans to give every child in the United States one SpaceX share each next year, but has not explained how the giveaway would work. Musk has previously floated ideas that did not materialize, so it remains unclear whether this plan will go ahead.

item.title: TIME Best Inventions 2026: Why did new Apple CEO John Ternus land cover alongside iPhone Duo?
item.description: The recognition came just weeks after John Ternus succeeded Tim Cook in September, marking a generational shift for Apple

item.title: Delhi HC imposes fine of ₹1 on Niva Bupa Health Insurance: What’s the case? Why the amount? Explained
item.description: Niva Bupa Health Insurance must pay Re 1 after the Delhi High Court found it had misused the court’s specialised IP jurisdiction in a lawsuit against influencer Vishal Rattewal.&nbsp;

item.title: Even Healthcare raises $50 million from Khosla Ventures to expand its hospital network across Bengaluru
item.description: Led by Khosla Ventures, the funding will help Even expand to five Bengaluru hospitals by early 2027 as healthcare startups and hospital groups look to integrate care, insurance and prevention.

item.title: TVS Capital eyes six deeptech, manufacturing bets in Fund IV
item.description: TVS Capital plans at least six investments across deeptech and manufacturing through its latest fund, while prioritising proprietary IP and cautioning against stretched AI valuations.

item.title: Good news for beer lovers in Tamil Nadu! TASMAC plans to add four new beer varieties — check prices and what’s coming
item.description: TASMAC plans to introduce four beer varieties in Tamil Nadu by year-end, with prices starting at ₹250, pending approval. They will be available at regular and elite outlets. Its online portal lets customers check prices, pay and collect orders using a QR code, but does not provide home delivery.

item.title: Is the worst of AI deflation over? Depends on which IT boss you ask
item.description: India's leading IT services companies disagree on how long AI-driven revenue deflation will persist, highlighting uncertainty over the industry's growth outlook.

item.title: StayVista looks to acquire other businesses, expand into resorts and events
item.description: Holiday-home operator StayVista is seeking to boost property use and revenue by managing resorts, offering rooms individually and hosting events.&nbsp;

item.title: Tata Sons row: What is Article 118, and why does it matter for N Chandrasekaran's third term? | Explained
item.description: A dispute over Tata Sons’ Articles of Association has cast doubt on N Chandrasekaran’s five-year reappointment as executive chairman. Noel Tata says Article 118 applies and no selection committee was formed.&nbsp;

item.title: Indian IT giants' H-1B visa registrations fall amid Trump's crackdown; Infosys, Cognizant, TCS report fewer entries
item.description: H-1B registrations by Infosys, TCS and Cognizant fell sharply for FY2027 amid higher visa costs and a wage-weighted selection system. The figures reflect fresh entries in the annual cap selection process, rather than total H-1B employment.

item.title: UBS capital rules have Swiss stuck between a rock and a hard place
item.description: UBS GROUP-REGULATION/ (PIX):UBS capital rules have Swiss stuck between a rock and a hard place

item.title: From Ambani to Delta: why Elon Musk has picked fights over Starlink
item.description: Starlink's growth now depends on new markets and big customers, and its rivals are catching up.

item.title: Akasa Air’s revenue rises 35%, but profitability remains elusive
item.description: Akasa Air’s revenue grew 35% in FY26 as its fleet and network expanded, but its net loss widened 37%. Foreign-exchange losses, aircraft costs and financing expenses weighed on profitability.

item.title: Microsoft pulls out of Nscale’s UK AI data centre project - here is what happened
item.description: Located in Loughton, Essex, the Microsoft data centre was scheduled to open next year.

item.title: Delhi CM approves setting up of Go-Delhi Foundation with ₹50 crore corpus to help startups: Here's what it will do
item.description: Delhi government has approved the Go-Delhi Foundation with a ₹50 crore corpus to support startups and innovators. It will offer testing facilities, guidance, and investor connections, while helping government departments trial new solutions.&nbsp;

item.title: Accenture weighs $1.5 billion sale of Greater China operations amid AI shift, hires JPMorgan for review: Report
item.description: The strategic review comes at a time when Accenture is re-evaluating its resource allocation. Investors are currently debating the long-term impact of AI on the consulting sector.

item.title: Ahead of IPO, AI firm Anthropic announces a new ‘public benefit fund’ to commit 5% of its stocks: What we know
item.description: Anthropic plans to commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, subject to stockholder approval, with scope to expand the stake as its value grows. Elon Musk suggested giving shares directly to the public. The announcement comes ahead of the AI firm’s IPO, reportedly scheduled for November.

item.title: Food services platform Focus Prism raises ₹145 crore from OAKS, buys Chennai-based catering firm FoodExo
item.description: The bulk of the fresh funding financed the cash-and-stock deal as the catering startup targets ₹700 crore in revenue this fiscal year through market consolidation.

item.title: India a keystone for Hitachi Energy supply chain amid global power crunch: CEO
item.description: Hitachi Energy CEO Andreas Schierenbeck said rising demand from data centres and the shift from oil and gas to electricity across industries have intensified industrial power needs in recent years, creating a mismatch between supply and demand.

item.title: Tata Sons breaks from the past and drops Article 118 reference in Chandrasekaran’s third-term resolution
item.description: Tata Trusts chair Noel Tata had pointed out that the same board had earlier followed Article 118 to reappoint Chandrasekaran, but did not do so on 17 September.

item.title: Sydney’s New $4 Billion Airport Opens With Barely Any Flights
item.description: After more than half a century of political procrastination, environmental protests and funding shortfalls, Sydney finally has a second airport. But the new A$5.6 billion ($4 billion) site’s commercial prospects are already in question.

item.title: Who is Amal Kelshikar? Why did he resign from the position of Torrent Pharmaceuticals' Executive Director? Explained
item.description: Torrent Pharmaceuticals accepted Executive Director Amal Kelshikar’s resignation, effective at the close of business on 16 October 2026. Kelshikar said in his resignation letter that he was stepping down after reflection and believed it was the right time to transition.
